description: Evaluate a custom formula over BCA primitives (coverage_index, sentiment_velocity, price_change_7d, risk_score, each taking an entity slug; operators + - * /) on 7 day values. Returns the computed value plus each function's component value. Unseeded when a value the formula needs is not computed yet; a formula the evaluator cannot parse is an error. Pro tier.

formula.description: Formula over BCA primitives with entity slugs as arguments, e.g. 'coverage_index(ethereum) / price_change_7d(ethereum)'. Functions: coverage_index, sentiment_velocity, price_change_7d, risk_score; operators + - * /.

target.description: Not read by the API: name the entity slugs inside the formula instead.

name: build_custom_indicator
